description_en: Queries the top N most visited URLs for website services within a specified time period
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内网站业务访问量最大的前N个URL
name: DescribeDomainViewTopUrl

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS 高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组 ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the exact minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the exact minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.

The domain name must have a website service forwarding rule configured. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。

域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The number of URLs to return. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: top

parameters.help_en:
The step size for returning data, in seconds. This parameter specifies the interval at which a result is returned. The supported step size varies based on the query time range (determined by StartTime and EndTime). Recommended settings:

Query time range of up to 1 hour: minimum step size of 60 seconds, maximum not exceeding the query time range.
Query time range of more than 1 hour but up to 6 hours: minimum step size of 600 seconds, maximum not exceeding the query time range.
Query time range of more than 6 hours but up to 24 hours: minimum step size of 1800 seconds, maximum not exceeding the query time range.
Query time range of more than 24 hours but up to 7 days: minimum step size of 3600 seconds, maximum not exceeding the query time range.
Query time range of more than 7 days but up to 15 days: minimum step size of 14400 seconds, maximum not exceeding the query time range.
Query time range of more than 15 days: minimum step size of 43200 seconds, maximum not exceeding the query time range
parameters.help_zh:
设置返回数据的步长，单位为秒，即每隔多少秒返回一个结果。查询时间范围（由StartTime和EndTime决定）不同，支持的步长取值范围不同，设置建议如下：

查询时间范围不大于1小时，建议最小步长为60秒，最大不超过查询时间范围。
查询时间范围大于1小时但不超过6小时，建议最小步长为600秒，最大不超过查询时间范围。
查询时间范围大于6小时但不超过24小时，建议最小步长为1800秒，最大不超过查询时间范围。
查询时间范围大于24小时但不超过7天，建议最小步长为3600秒，最大不超过查询时间范围。
查询时间范围大于7天但不超过15天，建议最小步长为14400秒，最大不超过查询时间范围。
查询时间范围大于15天，建议最小步长为43200秒，最大不超过查询时间范围
parameters.name: inerval

UrlList.description_en: The list of top URLs by access volume for the website service
UrlList.description_zh: 网站业务的访问量 TOP URL 列表

Url.description_en: The URL. The value is Base64-encoded
